title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters 3 - Dec #153 The Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics 1991
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible comic book featuring the iconic character Cerebus the Aardvark. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in 1991, this issue number 3 of the series titled "Cerebus Mothers & Daughters" is a must-have for fans and collectors of US Comics. 

The artist and writer of this piece is Dave Sim, who is known for his exceptional talent in creating compelling stories and characters. This comic book is a part of the tradition of US Comics and falls under the genre of Comics & Graphic Novels. It is a great addition to any collection of Comic Books & Memorabilia.
